caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron railing or fence section rendered primarily in shades of black and gray, with some accents in brown. The railing features two vertical posts with feet at the base, supporting a rectangular frame. The upper and lower sections of the railing consist of a repeating diamond lattice pattern, with small circular floral motifs at each intersection point. The central panel contains an ornate symmetrical design, where four large feathered leaves radiate diagonally from a central circular node, each leaf adorned with scrolling and curling elements. The spaces between these leaves are filled with additional swirling lines and circular accents. On the rightmost section, there are four closely spaced vertical bars depicted in a rust-brown color, separated from the main central design by another vertical support. The background is tan or beige with some lightly shaded architectural details suggesting a floor and part of a wall, faintly rendered in brown and cream hues.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
